title: El verbo ser: soy, eres, es, son
titleEn: The verb ser (to be): soy, eres, es, son
source: Slide 21, the Guapo worksheet, and the Todo sobre mí worksheet
summary: The verb 'to be' as the class has used it so far: es (one person or thing), son (more than one), soy (I), eres (you).
explanation: But wait! There's one last thing you need to make a complete sentence: a verb! Start with the verb 'to be': es = (s/he/it) is, son = (they / you guys) are.
Use es for one person or thing and son for more than one: El carro es rápido. Los carros son rápidos.
From the songs and worksheets you have also seen: soy = I am (Soy guapo. Yo soy de California.) and eres = you are (Tú no eres guapo, eres feo. ¿De dónde eres?).

examples.en: I am tall. I am thin.

examples.es: Tú no eres guapo, eres feo.
examples.en: You are not good-looking, you are ugly.

items.prompt: Ellos ___ estudiantes de USC y UCLA.
Víctor piensa que los anteojos ___ feos.
